headword: {管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}

definitions.explanation: A nationally licensed nutrition professional in Japan, one rank above the {栄養士|えいようし}. They plan and manage diets and give nutritional guidance in hospitals, schools, and welfare facilities.

examples.japanese: {管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a registered dietitian.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: She works as a registered dietitian at a hospital.

examples.japanese: {管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: To earn the registered dietitian qualification, you must pass the national examination.

notes:
A national qualification, ranked above the ⟦{栄養士|えいようし}→栄養士：29375_eiyoushi⟧. The licence is granted by the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare after passing a national exam.
